name: Blue Moon MK1 (Endurance)

surface_window.note: The landing date is not published.

outcome_note: Will deliver two NASA science payloads to the lunar south pole. In integrated testing as of August 2026; thermal-vacuum testing at NASA Johnson completed.

payloads.name: Stereo Cameras for Lunar Plume-Surface Studies 1.x
payloads.purpose: High-resolution cameras documenting the descent and plume effects.

payloads.name: Laser Retroreflector Array
payloads.purpose: Passive retroreflectors serving as a precise location marker.

sources.title: NASA Provides Updates on Moon Base Cargo Landers, Tech Demonstrations (Aug 04, 2026)
NASA Selects Blue Origin to Deliver VIPER Rover to Moon's South Pole (RELEASE 25-064, Sep 19, 2025)

notes: NASA's Sept 2025 release targeted launch 'later this year'; the Aug 2026 update shows it still in testing, so no current date is asserted.
